name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 2 Setting Up Your Google Business Profile
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
How to create, verify and fully complete a Google Business Profile, the cornerstone of local SEO.

# Steps
1. Claim or create at google.com/business; exact name, address or service area, local phone, most accurate primary category (study competitors' categories).
2. Verify (postcard, phone, email or video). Unverified listings do not rank well.
3. Complete every field: logo, cover, 5+ photos to start (interior, exterior, team, work), hours, description that names services and location, attributes, products/services.
4. Keyword-named image files (for example `Seattle-Plumber-team.jpg`).
5. Keep it active: posts, Q&A answers, special and holiday hours, messaging.

# Pitfalls
Keyword stuffing the business name, virtual offices or P.O. boxes, skipping verification.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- GBP is read-only for Claude on Pipeliners and Summit AZ; Scott handles Alphalete's GBP. Output recommendations only ([Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile)).
- Scott's photo rule for GBP: internal pipe damage or lining work only, never under-sink plumbing.
